items.cause: Research answers from memory instead of searching (ungrounded answers).
items.evidence: About a third of calls were genuine grounded searches on 09-27, 24 stub rows; the full prompt grounded 9 of 24 in the test. Cause: prompt size and our own 120 s timeout, not quota.
items.controls: Narrow-first prompt (24 of 24 in the test; 130 of 130 rows grounded, 0 stubs on the first live Saturday); grounding trail and health file every run; 5-row canary before the window; circuit breaker.
items.remains: The narrow prompt has not yet run on awards (first scheduled run Fri 10-09). Rollback is one environment variable (CFP_PROMPT_MODE=full).

items.cause: Research cites pages it never opened, or composes URL paths that do not exist.
items.evidence: 7 of 14 first-try gate failures were HTTP 404 on composed or stale URLs; the cited host was not among the search sources for 30 to 35% of rows; the canary reported '404' without having observed it; 15 new dead links and 62 backlog on the 10-04 sweep.
items.controls: Gate checks that the cited page exists; weekly verify confirms dead links in a real browser; hand-back list to upstream; the real-URL finder uses only addresses taken from a site's own sitemap and menu (12 of 14 right, 0 wrong in test; shadow run from 10-10).
items.remains: Composed URLs still arrive every week and the fix depends on upstream replacing them. The finder is not yet a fallback in the weekly path.

items.cause: Quotes are paraphrased, not verbatim.
items.evidence: 5 of 14 first-try gate failures: the date is on the page, the wording is not.
items.controls: Mechanical repairs for wording-only mistakes (contract v2.4, never changes a claim); gate quote check; the reader must return a literal sentence that code finds on the page.
items.remains: A paraphrase on a page that has since changed still ends as unproven.

items.cause: A blank answer replaces a verified one.
items.evidence: The first live load blanked verified evidence on 3 future deadlines (16 database cells and 19 file cells restored from backup).
items.controls: Evidence-carry rule (a blank quote never replaces verified evidence); load QA flags any lost deadline, evidence, quote or link; backups, invariants, watch-list; replay of the case confirms the fix.
items.remains: Hand-loaded rows that are not in the approved file get no carry the first Saturday (see D6).

items.cause: Research overrides or contradicts a ruling a person made after reading the event's own page.
items.evidence: Research returned a different, evidenced deadline for rows corrected by hand (abstract vs paper deadline; an aggregator date; a wrong start date); 15 events are pinned.
items.controls: Pinned rows ledger applied before the gate on every load; blank pins clear the database; 'Verified by you' panel; answer key generated from the same ledger.
items.remains: A pin holds one edition; the next edition is a new row. Awards have no pins yet (priority 5). A ruling only protects once it is entered.

items.cause: Fields the short research question does not ask come back blank or as stale text from the input list.
items.evidence: Organizer blank on all 130 rows; a venue in CITY on 28 rows; input-list dates on 66 rows.
items.controls: Narrow overlay keeps last week's same-edition value for unasked fields (organizer blank 130 -> 14 and 2; venue in CITY 28 -> 1 and 0); load QA tracks blank rates.
items.remains: Carried values are last week's, not re-verified (see D3 and D8).

items.cause: Research states a date or status for an edition that no page states (wrong year, next or previous edition).
items.evidence: 2027 start dates inside 2026 editions; one case that looked like this and was not (the page did state the 2027 date); a page that shows next year's edition.
items.controls: Year checks Y1 to Y4 on every row of every load; load QA lists any start date the load introduced on a projected row with no evidence; trap cases; the reader accepts a date only if the quote states that year.
items.remains: No prompt rule yet. A plausible guess with no page can still reach a projected row; a flag is for a person to confirm, not proof it is wrong.

items.cause: A row yields nothing (a stub) because every search attempt failed.
items.evidence: 24 stubs on 09-27, 0 on the narrow-prompt Saturday; 10 stubs in the 10-02 awards file.
items.controls: Narrow prompt; circuit breaker after consecutive stubs; a stub keeps last week's accepted row ('kept-last-week').
items.remains: Awards stub rate under the narrow prompt is unmeasured until Fri 10-09.

items.cause: Quota exhaustion, timeouts and 504s stop the research window.
items.evidence: Quota was exhausted once (2026-08-04); a 120 s ceiling made failures costlier without rescuing calls.
items.controls: Circuit breaker (exit 3 and 4), per-request timeout, rate limiter over every request, canary, retries.
items.remains: Quota is account-level and shared (see E9).

items.cause: Upstream's writer produces malformed files.
items.evidence: Unquoted commas (47 fields, the Market column holding dates) repeatedly; four times in two days.
items.controls: repair_delivery.py; format checks in the gate; we read, they format.
items.remains: Upstream's writer is unfixed, so it recurs.

items.cause: Statements about upstream's own files do not match what is on disk.
items.evidence: Three false 'it is in the file' claims, ids that do not exist here, input lists claimed stamped but not (10-02 to 10-04).
items.controls: check_delivery_ids.py (claims are checked on disk first); gate note S (ACCEPTED is not the same as researched); the upstream QA protocol.
items.remains: The check is run by hand on each delivery.

items.cause: Status and lifecycle claims without evidence (discontinued, merged, out of scope).
items.evidence: Two rulings with no R16 evidence and ids we do not hold; an 'out of scope' ruling on six events the customer tracks, reversed.
items.controls: Gate R16 needs the event's own page and a verbatim quote; such rows are held and keep blank dates.
items.remains: Waiting on upstream's evidence for the open cases.

items.cause: Sponsorship 'Yes' is accepted with a link but no quote, and sponsorship questions dominate the weekend's cost.
items.evidence: About 90% Yes on both markets with 0 quotes; sponsorship passes are about 70% of a weekend.
items.controls: Sponsorship carry-forward (option A) is live.
items.remains: A quote requirement is a contract question for upstream; option B and a reader pass are not built.

items.cause: Events the customer tracks are not on our research list.
items.evidence: 41 verified, dated customer events have no match of ours (29 Arnica, 12 Utility), mostly older or out of scope; the live ones are covered (coverage 100%).
items.controls: Coverage is measured from the database; the six reversed events were loaded.
items.remains: Needs a decision on which of the 41 are live and worth adding.

items.cause: Renamed, closed and successor events are not handled deliberately.
items.evidence: Not tested; a probable duplicate pair is held with blank dates; trap case T06 needs a person to judge.
items.controls: Identity rules (never mint an id, never join on upstream ids) prevent the worst outcome.
items.remains: There is no test that the method keeps two names of one event, or two events of one brand, apart.

items.cause: The page that states the call is not found, or not selected.
items.evidence: FIND failed 7 rows in the first live load; the sitemap plus menu method reached a call page at 31 of 84 sites; the finder selected a page that states the known deadline for 13 of 14 events.
items.controls: Real-URL finder (sitemap, menu, home page, frozen page rules, main-call rule): 12 of 14 right, 0 wrong, versus 8 of 14 for the grounded call on the same events; shadow run every Saturday from 10-10.
items.remains: Not in the weekly path yet; about 2.7 minutes per event; sub-summit pages are not selected; n = 14.

items.cause: The page cannot be read by a plain fetch (HTTP 403 wall, anti-bot, script-built content).
items.evidence: Rows that read 'unconfirmed' because of a 403; a script-built page returning no text; a walled page failing the quote check.
items.controls: Real-Chrome render fallback in the reader; the gate reports a walled page as a note, not a failure; offline page library (350 of 360 pages usable); hard anti-bot hosts skipped by design.
items.remains: The weekly verifier cannot fall back to the render (priority 10).

items.cause: Links die between runs (moved pages, expired call pages, stale evidence pages).
items.evidence: 15 new dead links and 62 backlog on 10-04; 10 of the 15 are evidence pages for editions that have passed.
items.controls: Weekly verify confirms each dead link in a real browser and lists it; hand-back to upstream.
items.remains: Replacement depends on upstream; nothing proposes a replacement automatically.

items.cause: The page shows another edition, or two editions at once.
items.evidence: A page showing next year's edition; a page with both editions; a header date with no year beside it.
items.controls: Year-specific reading; nearest-heading year rule checked in code; trap cases T01 and T02; the reader stays blank rather than guess.
items.remains: Pages with no year beside the date stay blank (safe, but a lost answer).

items.cause: Several calls on one site (posters, awards, workshops, tracks) and the wrong one is read.
items.evidence: 3 of 14 events returned a real date for a different call.
items.controls: Main-call rule: set aside other calls, prefer the page named for the call, earliest open date. 0 wrong in 14.
items.remains: No tested event had competing rounds; the rule is inverted for awards and not yet built.

items.cause: A third-party or aggregator page is cited in place of the organizer's.
items.evidence: An aggregator that does not list the event cited as evidence (trap case T05, a known gap).
items.controls: A pin handled the one known case.
items.remains: No automatic aggregator-citation flag (priority 11).

items.cause: The date is only on the home page, or on a sub-event page inside a larger site.
items.evidence: Home-page-only dates on two sites; a sub-summit inside a larger event site not selected.
items.controls: The home page is always read as one extra page.
items.remains: Sub-event pages inside a larger site are not selected.

items.cause: Sites with no usable links or menus.
items.evidence: Six of 84 sites (4 alias sites, 2 script-built menus).
items.controls: None specific.
items.remains: Not addressed.

items.cause: A page changes or vanishes after we read it, and the weekly path keeps no versioned snapshot.
items.evidence: An offline library of 360 pages was fetched once (10-01); the refresh-by-lifecycle policy was designed and not built.
items.controls: Weekly verify re-reads cited pages.
items.remains: Refresh scheduler for conferences (priority 9).

items.cause: New events and next editions are not discovered.
items.evidence: Only the monthly sweep discovers events and it is disabled for prospect markets; the Sunday discovery looked at 6 rows and applied 1.
items.controls: Sunday discovery for known rows.
items.remains: Ideas not built: a countdown timer signals the next edition; sitemap dates.

items.cause: The wrong kind of date is taken as the submission deadline (registration, early-bird, event, notification, ceremony).
items.evidence: Fixed rules failed on a fresh test (precision 0.33); the whole-page reader had precision 0.85 and one ceremony date taken as a deadline.
items.controls: The model picks, code proves (verbatim quote, year-specific, call wording); 0 wrong in 73 reads, and 0 in about 95 answers earlier.
items.remains: Samples are small; one reader.

items.cause: The year or edition is misread (two-digit year styles, a year taken from elsewhere on the page).
items.evidence: The '(26)' style was read 0 of 35 times, false positives 5 of 322.
items.controls: Whole-date matching: 35 of 35 on 350 saved pages, 0 of 322 false positives; year checks in the load.
items.remains: Other unusual year styles, if any, would appear as blanks.

items.cause: Date formats and layouts the reader does not know (other languages, ordinals, ranges, dd.mm.yyyy).
items.evidence: Recall on verified facts was 62%; after the limiters 75% to 81%, 0 wrong.
items.controls: Other-language month names, numeric formats, ordinals, range expansion, browser render, heading-year rule.
items.remains: No year beside the date; two date ranges on one page (training and conference); country from a state.

items.cause: Start date disagrees with the dates text or the input list.
items.evidence: 66 start-date conflicts; where a page proved anything it proved the research date (5 of 5) and never the input text.
items.controls: Start-date arbiter, overlay restore of the dates text, year checks; now 0 year failures and agreement on 49 Utility and 63 Cybersecurity rows.
items.remains: None known.

items.cause: Several rounds or tracks (early, regular, late; abstract versus paper) and the wrong one is shipped.
items.evidence: Abstract vs paper deadlines; a registration end read as a proposal deadline.
items.controls: Earliest open round by default; the main-call rule; pins for rulings.
items.remains: The arbiter does not yet pick the earliest of two deadlines on one page (trap case T04, a known gap).

items.cause: A 'verified' label means the call status was confirmed, not the date.
items.evidence: 13 of 48 stored deadlines were 'verified' from the status layer; 5 more had no evidence page.
items.controls: All board figures count proof from quoted evidence, never from the label.
items.remains: The stored verification label itself still conflates the two.

items.cause: The same page gives different answers on different runs (reader variance).
items.evidence: A reader found 7, 10 and 9 of 16 facts on identical input; one event passed and then returned blank.
items.controls: Blank is the safe failure; repeated runs; the older model recovers more.
items.remains: Two-model agreement is proposed and not run.

items.cause: Text fields are misread (a venue as the city, a country inferred, a format guessed).
items.evidence: A hotel name stored as a city; 'Park City' read as a venue and stored 'UT'; a country inferred that was not in the quote.
items.controls: A value must appear inside its own quote; venue words are flagged by load QA; city cleaning fixed.
items.remains: No measure of accuracy per field (see D3).

items.cause: Look-alike numbers and time zones ('October 2' matched in 'October 12'; a deadline in another zone).
items.evidence: Trap cases T11 and T12.
items.controls: Whole-date matching; both cases pass.
items.remains: None known.

items.cause: An event cannot be tied to one permanent id (no id returned, a rename, a second row for one event, ids we do not hold).
items.evidence: The largest failure step: 11 rows (3 Cybersecurity, 8 Utility) in the first live load; duplicates and renames in the first weeks.
items.controls: Ids are stamped on the input and carried through; identity.to_canonical (never join on upstream ids); we never mint an id; a row with no id is held, never guessed.
items.remains: About 11 rows a week still cannot load fresh until upstream returns the stamped ids (note 26).

items.cause: Silent loss or regression during a load.
items.evidence: Four rows deleted silently (08-08); rows missing after a multi-market import; evidence lost in the first live load (10-03).
items.controls: Backup before every load, invariant checks with automatic rollback, load QA, watch-list, second-process read-back.
items.remains: None known.

items.cause: Non-deadline facts (city, venue, format, organizer, categories) are wrong or unproven and nothing measures them.
items.evidence: 3 of 7 upstream events carried a wrong city, venue or date; 47 of 85 candidate facts could not be proven from the pages.
items.controls: Overlay, venue-in-city flag, answer-key candidates from the reader.
items.remains: A weekly reader pass on these fields (priority 6) is proposed, not built.

items.cause: The same event appears as two rows.
items.evidence: A duplicate of one event under a 2026 key; two names for one summit with the same URL and date; a German OWASP duplicate.
items.controls: Duplicate rule R15; rows are held rather than merged without evidence.
items.remains: Upstream must retire the duplicates with evidence.

items.cause: Canonical keys move (a city or venue in the key, a key built from the name).
items.evidence: A tidy-up rewrote 26 cities and 24 keys with every test passing; a venue or postcode in a key.
items.controls: key_year frozen from the edition, keys from the city never the venue, golden-master diff read before blessing, invariants.
items.remains: None known.

items.cause: Data enters outside the process (hand edits, rows loaded by hand) and breaks signing or carry.
items.evidence: A hand edit broke Monday's publish; hand-loaded rows had no carry and lost evidence.
items.controls: Re-gate and re-promote procedure; pins; the publish guard.
items.remains: Hand-loaded rows are not added to the approved file automatically (priority 4).

items.cause: The customer's own view disagrees with ours (another edition, an earlier round, withdrawn rows, events they track that we lack).
items.evidence: Agreement 14 of 15 live rows; 3 other-edition rows and 1 far-future blank shown, not scored; 41 tracked events without a match.
items.controls: Customer intake read before research; withdrawn rows excluded; other-edition class; customer agreement used as accuracy evidence.
items.remains: The coverage gap needs a decision (A14).

items.cause: A carried value outlives its truth (carry rules keep last week's organizer, evidence, sponsorship).
items.evidence: A new risk created by the carry rules; no case yet.
items.controls: Same-edition only; load QA; verified evidence carried only for the same or a future deadline.
items.remains: No age limit on a carried fact.

items.cause: Rows whose deadline has passed look unproven for ever.
items.evidence: Of 39 stored deadlines 9 were proven; 16 absent and 12 unreadable were mostly passed deadlines.
items.controls: All proof figures are scored on live deadlines only.
items.remains: The old rows have not been reviewed.

items.cause: A passed deadline shipped with STATUS Open.
items.evidence: 8 awards held back on the 10-02 file.
items.controls: The gate holds such rows and the row rule keeps last week's version. [ACT-02, verified 2026-10-05]
items.remains: Closed once upstream's corrected patch is loaded; watch for the next passed-deadline-Open row.

items.cause: Accidental whole-database operations.
items.evidence: A re-verify without a market scope changed 13 rows' verification state.
items.controls: The unrestricted form is refused; changes are rehearsed on a copy first.
items.remains: None known.

items.cause: Customer pages built from an edited, stale or unsigned file.
items.evidence: A hand edit made Monday's page refuse to publish (hash mismatch).
items.controls: Publish guard: the approved file must be signed, accepted, unchanged and fresh; the recap says will or will not publish.
items.remains: None known.

items.cause: The weekend job does not load, silently.
items.evidence: On 10-03 the load step never ran: a step list flattened into one array and Python started with single characters.
items.controls: Steps built whole by one function; empty input to Python; a missing-script guard; a test that runs the real step builder (-ListPostSteps) and checks every step; Saturday's task limit 5 hours.
items.remains: The first fully automatic load is Sat 10-10.

items.cause: A stray prompt or hang holds the window for hours.
items.evidence: The 10-03 hang.
items.controls: Empty stdin, 5-hour task limit (was 10), hang procedure in the runbook.
items.remains: None known.

items.cause: Money and time are spent asking questions whose answer cannot have changed.
items.evidence: Searches are 73% of cost; sponsorship passes about 70% of a weekend; 11 of 93 calls went on ended events (08-11); 76 of 129 awards are Closed.
items.controls: Awards refresh plan (35% skipped, about $2.60 a week, rehearsed: identical result); sponsorship carry; customer intake before research.
items.remains: The awards plan is unproven live; the conference refresh scheduler is not built (priority 9).

items.cause: A new automated step fails in its first live runs.
items.evidence: The narrow prompt, the load step and evidence handling all showed defects in their first live run.
items.controls: Sandbox rehearsal with the production checks, the canary, the list-steps test.
items.remains: First live runs ahead: awards Fri 10-09 (narrow prompt, refresh plan, load_awards) and Sat 10-10 (load, per-step trend, shadow run).

items.cause: Tool and environment traps (sandboxed copies of folders, PowerShell quoting, a locked database, a UI running the live build).
items.evidence: Documented in the runbook's failure-mode table.
items.controls: Absolute paths, verify from the far side of a process boundary, the failure-mode table.
items.remains: Relies on discipline.

items.cause: Process documentation drifts from the scripts.
items.evidence: Documents were told to be read and gave old truth.
items.controls: A fingerprint guard (22 scripts) says when the weekend process document is out of date; the tooling index; the QA register.
items.remains: None known.

items.cause: Throwaway code duplicates or contradicts existing tooling (a wrong join, a false count).
items.evidence: A throwaway comparison reported all 112 rows missing by joining on the upstream id; about 20 throwaways in one day.
items.controls: Announce 'USING EXISTING' or 'NEW CODE' before any code; the tooling index; reuse of the existing scripts.
items.remains: Relies on discipline.

items.cause: A recap says something that did not happen.
items.evidence: 'Loaded automatically' after a by-hand load.
items.controls: Dry-run and read a recap before sending by hand.
items.remains: Manual step.

items.cause: Two jobs touch the same database or quota at once.
items.evidence: Quota is account-level; two audits against one database must never overlap.
items.controls: Procedure: check the scheduled tasks before running anything by hand.
items.remains: No lock enforces it.

items.cause: A reported number is wrong, hard-coded or badly defined.
items.evidence: A 28% provable figure counted 44 of 48 deadlines that had passed; 40 rows counted customer-withdrawn rows; a weighted index counted the same check twice; counts hard-coded in strings.
items.controls: Board figures derived from the database with written definitions, live rows only; Complete % and Accurate % replace the weighted index; tests.
items.remains: Several measures rest on small samples (see F4).

items.cause: A claim is treated as fact before it is checked against the data (ours and upstream's).
items.evidence: A defect report blamed upstream wrongly (08-08); a date cleared wrongly after a summary was taken for a read of the page (10-03); this week an estimate of 45 seconds per event, a reason for a low awards score and the urgency of 15 dead links were each stated and later corrected.
items.controls: Verify against the data before it leaves the building; claims about files are checked on disk; rehearsal on copies; a pin only when the operator said so; corrections written down.
items.remains: It recurred several times this week. The control depends on discipline, not on code.

items.cause: The same fact is verified by a person more than once.
items.evidence: Several events were manually re-verified across days.
items.controls: A fact you verify is pinned, applied the same day, added to the answer key and shown on the board; you are not asked again.
items.remains: A pin holds one edition; the share of events needing a manual check per month is not yet measured.

items.cause: Ground truth is thin, so improvements cannot be scored with confidence.
items.evidence: The answer key holds 51 facts for 15 of the 40 benchmark events; the finder comparison is 14 events and its gold favours the grounded call; awards have no answer key.
items.controls: Answer-key candidates from the reader (85 facts, 0 disagreements); trap cases (14); the shadow run adds evidence each Saturday.
items.remains: The answer-key decision and an awards key (priorities 7 and 8).

items.cause: Knowledge is lost between sessions.
items.evidence: Context is lost between conversations.
items.controls: HANDOFF, worklog, QA register, runbook, board, long-term memory notes.
items.remains: Relies on keeping them current.
